title: Q32 Bio Inc. 8-K Filing — 2026-04-24
summary: Q32 Bio Inc. filed an 8-K announcing completion of a $14.2 million at-the-market (ATM) equity offering and the filing of a new prospectus supplement for up to $75 million in additional share sales through Cantor Fitzgerald as sales agent.
key_points: Q32 Bio Inc. completed its prior ATM offering of $14.2 million aggregate shares on April 24, 2026.
The company filed a new prospectus supplement for up to $75 million in additional common stock sales under the same Sales Agreement with Cantor Fitzgerald.
The new offering is backed by a shelf registration statement (Form S-3, File No. 333-286491) declared effective April 21, 2025.
Goodwin Procter LLP provided a legal opinion (Exhibit 5.1) for the additional shares.
The company's common stock trades on Nasdaq Capital Market under symbol QTTB.
